capabilities: View and edit Word documents with pages, styles, tables, headers and tracked changes
Edit PowerPoint presentations with slide editing, transitions and a slideshow with presenter view
Edit Excel spreadsheets with about 90 live-recalculated formulas, charts and pivot tables
Embed Office files or ranges of them in notes and create linked companion notes
Export documents to PDF, slides to PNG, sheets to CSV and notes to .docx or Markdown
extras: README notes it is not yet listed in the community plugin store (installable via BRAT or manually) and warns users to disable other plugins that open the same file types.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as Markdown and can't open or edit .docx, .pptx or .xlsx files, so users must switch to external Office software.
summary: Office-file editor that opens, views and edits Word, PowerPoint and Excel files inside Obsidian without Office or LibreOffice.
